title: Senior Python Developer / Technical Lead – AI Agents
description:
**¡En Tecdata Engineering buscamos un/a Senior Python Developer / Technical Lead – AI Agents!**

**Ubicación:** Málaga  
**Modalidad:** Híbrida, con presencialidad en oficina 2-3 días por semana  
**Tecnologías:** Python, AI Agents, LangGraph, MCP y SDD  
**Idioma:** Inglés B2 alto  
**Proyecto:** Desarrollo de soluciones basadas en agentes de IA en un entorno internacional.

Buscamos profesionales con sólidos conocimientos de Python, experiencia trabajando con agentes de IA y capacidad para tomar decisiones técnicas de forma autónoma.

**¿Qué buscamos?**

* Experiencia avanzada en **Python**.
* Conocimientos de **AI Agents**, tool calling y **LangGraph**.
* Experiencia o conocimientos en **SDD (Specification-Driven Development)**.
* Familiaridad con conectores MCP (*Model Context Protocol*).
* Autonomía para definir especificaciones, validar resultados y garantizar la calidad técnica.
* Capacidad de análisis, criterio técnico y atención al detalle.
* Inglés B2 alto, especialmente para la comunicación oral en entornos internacionales.

**Responsabilidades**

* Desarrollar soluciones en Python utilizando motores de ejecución y conectores MCP.
* Trabajar siguiendo metodologías de desarrollo orientadas a especificaciones (SDD).
* Definir y validar especificaciones técnicas y criterios de aceptación.
* Revisar código y resultados antes de su aprobación.
* Colaborar con equipos internacionales en el diseño y evolución de soluciones basadas en agentes de IA.

**Dos posibles enfoques según experiencia**

* **Senior Python Developer:** desarrollo hands-on, definición autónoma de especificaciones y validación de resultados. Se requiere buen nivel de inglés escrito.
* **Technical Lead:** revisión técnica diaria del trabajo del equipo, validación de código y especificaciones, y participación en foros de arquitectura internacionales. Se requiere fluidez oral en inglés.

¿Te interesa participar en un proyecto de inteligencia artificial con tecnologías actuales y un entorno internacional? ¡Envíanos tu CV o contacta con nosotros para conocer más detalles!

title: Campaign Manager - Italian / French
description:
**What to expect at MediaMint?**

At MediaMint, we love people who shape their surroundings and are always eager to learn. We value honesty, integrity, and self-awareness above all. If you’re driven by both professional and personal growth, MediaMint is the right place for you.

**Job Description:**

We are looking for an experienced Campaign Manager – Client Services to manage end-to-end digital advertising campaigns across a multi-platform digital portfolio, including streaming services, websites, mobile applications, and social media platforms.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in digital media planning, campaign management, ad operations, digital video, Connected TV (CTV), and programmatic advertising. The candidate will collaborate with Sales teams, advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders to develop effective media plans, ensure seamless campaign execution, maximize revenue delivery, and provide exceptional client service.

The role also requires functional leadership, mentoring team members, resolving complex campaign challenges, and driving operational efficiencies across the EMEA region.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide pre-sale guidance, technical requirements, and strategic planning for advertising opportunities across TWDC’s on and off-platform digital portfolio
* Work with Sales and buyers to build and revise media plans that maximize revenue and meet client objectives
* Responsible for the collection, quality control review, and implementation of assets to ensure a timely and accurate campaign launch
* Compile screen shots, provide reporting, execute creative swaps, and field all other client requests during campaign lifecycle
* Collaborate with Specialized Ops and Sales teams to troubleshoot and execute campaigns
* Identify, track, and analyse key metrics to optimize campaign performance
* Ensure full delivery of contracted revenue across your book of business
* Work with Finance and Accounting teams to ensure accurate invoicing and revenue tracking
* Assist with client retention by delivering the highest standard of service during pre, mid, and post-campaign support phases
* Serve as a subject matter expert for digital video, CTV, and programmatic advertising, providing strategic consultation, performance insights, and market best practice guidance to sales teams, advertisers, and agency partners
* Act as a functional lead within Client Services, mentoring team members, sharing expertise on complex campaigns, and driving adoption of new products, capabilities, and operational standards
* Lead cross-functional initiatives with Client Services Account Managers across EMEA to improve campaign management processes, drive operational efficiencies, and establish best practices
* Offer support and expertise for additional sales partners in TWDC’s EMEA offices
* Engage with third party vendors that provide services to TWDC and our clients

**Requirements:**

* Graduate level or equivalent experience
* **Proficient in Italian / French Language.**
* **4+ years of advertising/marketing agency or vendor experience required**
* Experience supporting a wide array of clients and agencies
* Familiarity with media planning and management of multi-platform campaigns; experience with branded content distribution is advantageous
* Competency in campaign management and ad-serving systems with experience in Operative1, Google Ad Manager, FreeWheel, Magnite, and Salesforce being an added advantage, as is familiarity with social media buying platforms
* General understanding of advertising technology on websites, apps, and social media platforms with hands-on experience on the buy or sell side
* Demonstrated ability to launch and deliver digital advertising campaigns, both direct sold & programmatic
* Experience scaling revenue in non-guaranteed programmatic deals
* Good understanding of the digital marketplace, with a specific focus on video advertising in EMEA
* Familiarity working with large multinational companies and the accompanying complex processes

**Skills Required:**

* Highly motivated and driven problem solver
* Great attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to effectively prioritise and balance multiple campaigns simultaneously
* Analytical; able to review, assess, and strategize based on the results
* Able to step back and look at scenarios at a macro level, solving the immediate challenge and providing long term solutions
* Comfortable working independently or collaboratively with peers Confident and clear communicator
* A solution focused, commercial mindset
* Always focused on our guests and prioritizing the user experience
* Excited to work in a global organization with stakeholders across the world
* Good understanding of digital media and the advertising industry, particularly video and within EMEA
* IT savvy across core business applications and remote working tools (Microsoft Office 365 suite and AI tools such as Copilot & Claude)

**About MediaMint**

MediaMint is an AI-powered Revenue Operations services company dedicated to accelerating innovation and revenue growth for platforms and publishers worldwide. Our mission is to drive operational efficiency, scalability, customer satisfaction, and actionable insights through advanced technology, automation, and AI.

We partner with industry leaders across AdTech, Consumer, CTV, Publishing, and Retail. With 2000+ professionals and offices in Hyderabad (HQ), San Francisco, New York, Krakow, and Ilorin, we support both Fortune 500 companies and high-growth startups.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: 25,000.00€ - 28,000.00€ per year

Work Location: In person

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
**About Camlin**

Camlin is a global technology leader that operates with the vision of bringing revolutionary products to life for a wide range of industries, including power and rail, and also has interests in a number of R&D projects in a variety of scientific sectors.

At Camlin we believe in high quality engineering and design, allowing us to develop market leading products and services. In short, we love creating value for our customers by solving difficult problems. As of now, Camlin operates in over 20 countries worldwide.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

As a **Frontend Engineer**, you'll join a dynamic and innovative team focused on building cutting-edge solutions for the energy sector. Working closely with Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Product Owners, and Scrum Masters, you'll help create intuitive, high-performing web applications that transform complex data into meaningful insights.

Day to day, you'll be designing, developing, and maintaining modern web UIs and dashboards that enable users to visualise, analyse, and act on critical data. You'll also contribute to deployment pipelines, infrastructure improvements, and the ongoing evolution of our frontend architecture, helping to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-friendly solutions.

The team is building a platform that monitors and analyses the state of the electrical grid, providing real-time alerts when faults or power disruptions occur and helping to maintain reliable power for end consumers. The platform also delivers powerful analytics and visualisation capabilities, enabling users to better understand and manage assets across the energy network.

You'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies including **Vue.js, TypeScript, Mapbox, Plotly, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS**, while contributing to solutions that have a genuine impact on critical infrastructure. We encourage continuous learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing, giving you the opportunity to grow your skills while helping shape the future of our products.

Most importantly, you'll be part of a team that is passionate about using technology to solve complex real-world challenges. If you're excited by the opportunity to create intuitive user experiences and contribute to technology that supports the future of energy, we'd love to hear from you.

**TECH STACK**
--------------

* Vue 3
* TypeScript
* Mapbox
* Plotly
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* GitLab CI
* Ubuntu Linux
* AWS

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

* Design and develop reusable frontend framework components
* Design and develop modern web UI applications for SaaS platforms
* Support the migration of legacy web applications to modern JavaScript frameworks
* Contribute to Camlin's software development strategies and frontend best practices
* Participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies, design reviews, and technical discussions
* Support and improve web application CI/CD pipelines
* Champion software quality through practices such as unit testing, SAST, and SCA
* Design and implement secure, scalable, and maintainable web applications

**ESSENTIAL CRITERIA**
----------------------

* At least 3 years' experience as a Frontend Software Engineer
* Experience with Vue.js or a similar modern JavaScript framework
* Experience with testing frameworks and libraries such as Jest
* Practical knowledge of modern web application deployment infrastructure
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
* Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal

### **Why You'll Enjoy This Role**

This is an opportunity to work on meaningful products that combine data visualisation, analytics, and modern web technologies to support critical energy infrastructure. You'll collaborate with talented engineers across multiple disciplines, work with a modern technology stack, and have the freedom to contribute ideas that shape both the product and the way we work. If you enjoy building exceptional user experiences and solving complex technical challenges, you'll feel right at home here.

**Our Values**

* We work together
* We believe in people
* We won’t accept the ‘way it has always been done’
* We listen to learn
* We’re trying to do the right thing

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Individuals seeking employment at Camlin are considered without regards to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital states, ancestry, physical or mental disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

title: Office Manager & Property Listings Coordinator – Marbella
description:
Office Manager | Marbella Golden Mile | Luxury Real Estate

Key Real Estate, a leading luxury agency on Marbella’s Golden Mile, is looking for a **proactive and detail-oriented Office Manager** to keep our operations smooth and our listings shining.  
If you’re organized, tech-savvy, and thrive in a high-end environment, this is your chance to be part of Marbella’s most dynamic real estate team.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Manage, update, and maintain property listings across **Inmobalia CRM and major real estate portals**, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and high-quality presentation.
* Create and distribute **marketing newsletters** featuring new properties, exclusive listings, and company updates.
* Prepare and present **regular activity reports**, tracking completed tasks, listing performance, and key results.
* Coordinate **schedules, client communications, and daily office operations** to support the sales and rentals teams.
* Ensure that property information, photographs, descriptions, and marketing materials are accurate, complete, and up to date.

**What We’re Looking For**

Minimum **2 years of experience** in an administrative or office coordination role, preferably within the real estate industry.

**Previous experience with Inmobalia CRM is mandatory.**

**Fluent Spanish and English**, both written and spoken, are essential.

**Based in Marbella or the surrounding area**. This is a full-time, office-based position.

Confident using **digital tools**, including Google Workspace, CRM systems, Canva, and AI-powered tools.

Strong **organisational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities**.

Proactive, independent, and results-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to follow tasks through to completion.

**What We Offer**  
**A\*** stable, long-term role\* within a respected luxury real estate agency.  
**Competitive salary**.  
A motivating, elegant work environment on Marbella’s **Golden Mile**.
